gaps.sentence: The results differ sharply ___ last year's.
gaps.explanation: differ FROM something (one thing differs from another); differ WITH = disagree.

gaps.sentence: The minister refused to comment ___ the scandal.
We're excited ___ our trip to Peru.
Doctors say stress is a major cause ___ insomnia.
She smiled ___ the waiter and ordered tea.
The novel was translated ___ twelve languages.
gaps.explanation: translate FROM one language INTO another.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry ___ the exam — you're well prepared.
The song reminds me ___ my first holiday abroad.
gaps.explanation: remind somebody OF something = make them remember; remind somebody ABOUT = tell them not to forget.
